BookCloseDate.description: This setting corresponds to the Closing date preference in the QuickBooks Online Company Settings and specifies the date the books are closed: income and expense accounts are closed and net profit or loss is rolled up into the retained earnings account. Transactions before this date are protected from changes.

ClassTrackingPerTxn.description: This setting correspond to how classes are assigned when Track classes in QuickBooks Online Company Settings under Categories is set to On. If set to `true`, assign classes at the transaction level. Only one of `ClassTrackingPerTxnLine` or `ClassTrackingPerTxn` can be set to `true` at a given time. If Track classes is set to Off in company settings, both are set to `false`.

If Track classes is set to Off in company settings, both are set to `false`.

CustomerTerminology.description: This setting corresponds to the Customer label preference in QuickBooks Online Company Settings and specifies the term used by the company for customers. This string is used in many places throughout the QuickBooks UI having to do with sales-side activities. Possible values include: `Clients`, `Customers`, `Donors`, `Guests`, `Members`, `Patients`, `Tenants`.

DepartmentTerminology.description: Specifies the term used by the company for department. This string is used as a label on transaction forms. Possible values include: `Business`, `Department`, `Division`, `Location`, `Property`, `Store`, `Territory`. This is returned only if the company's Track location preference is enabled. See TrackDepartments for more details.

TaxForm.description: This setting corresponds to the Tax form preference in the QuickBooks Online Company Settings to specify the tax form your company files.

TaxYearMonth.description: This setting corresponds to the First month of income tax year preference in the QuickBooks Online Company Settings to specify the beginning of the company's fiscal year. Specify months as fulling spelled out: `January`, `February`, and so on.

TrackDepartments.description: This setting corresponds to the Track locations preference in QuickBooks Online Company Settings under Categories. If Track locations is set to On, this attribute is returned as `true` in the response. Otherwise, `false` is returned.

UseAccountNumbers.description: This setting corresponds to Enable account numbers in QuickBooks Online Company Settings.If set to `On`, account names are displayed with their corresponding account numbers in chart of accounts.If set to `off`, account numbers are not displayed with account names in chart of accounts.

AllowOnlineACHPayment.description: Specifies if this invoice can be paid with online bank transfers and corresponds to the Bank transfer check box on the QuickBooks UI. Active when the company is payments-enabled, i.e., `Preferences.SalesFormsPrefs.ETransactionPaymentEnabled` is set to `true` and the company has been onboarded for Affirm with an `ACTIVE` subscription status. If set to `true`, allow invoice to be paid with online Affirm payments. The Affirm check box is checked on the QuickBooks UI for this invoice. True by default if the company allows invoices to be paid with Affirm. If set to `false`, online Affirm payments are not allowed. The Affirm check box is not checked on the QuickBooks UI for this invoice. Defaults to the active subscription status. If a value is explicitly sent, that value is used. If no value is sent, the default value is used.

AllowOnlineCreditCardPayment.description: Specifies if online credit card payments are allowed for this invoice and corresponds to the Credit card check box on the QuickBooks UI. True by default if the company allows invoices to be paid with credit cards. If set to `false`, online credit card payments are not allowed. The Credit card check box is not checked on the QuickBooks UI for this invoice.

AllowOnlinePayPalPayment.description: Specifies if online PayPal/Venmo payments are allowed for this invoice and corresponds to the PayPal check box on the QuickBooks UI.
